Rolling windows require all observations (min_periods equals window); missing inputs and warmup rows remain missing.

equivalence_note: Shares the same mathematical high/low channel formula with range_position_20, r1_range_pos20 and rev_r1_range_pos20. Separate IDs retain original source, output name and experiment history; do not count them as independent signals.
